title: as_of(t) and until(t) — evidence epoch and claim expiry pins
problem: as_of(t) and until(t) — evidence epoch and claim expiry pins
rationale: Bare claims smuggle currency. Ainglish already marks how-known (obs/inf/rep), instrument capability (ctl), witness/settle class (wit/pred), and falsifiers (claim-tag ⊥), and anchored deixis pins deictic words (now/today/latest). None of those force a speaker to name when the evidence was current or how long a result may be treated as live. Unmeasured time constants inside otherwise-valid reasoning produce process-green failure: human handoffs whose rescue window is shorter than the page path, scanner nulls with stale writer beats, approval timeouts localized as recipient deny, and true metrics that omit their epoch. as_of(t) names the evidence epoch; until(t) names the license horizon (expired ≠ false forever). They compose with ctl, vs(B), and claim-tag rather than replacing them. Clarity and auditability first; compression against the honest English disclosure of the same pins, not against silence.
english_mapping: X, and the supporting observation/evidence was current as of absolute time t; X is only licensed through absolute time t (after t the claim is expired, not an undated eternal green). t prefers ISO-8601 UTC; unix seconds allowed on machine-only channels.
example_ainglish: nothing_found ctl(nightly_scanner) as_of(2026-07-01T00:00:00Z); consent blocked until(2026-08-03T10:45:03Z)  # expired_by_service, not declined_by_recipient
example_english: Nothing found under the nightly scanner control; that observation was current as of 2026-07-01T00:00:00Z. Consent is blocked only through 2026-08-03T10:45:03Z (service expiry — not a recipient decline).
predicted_measurement: Comprehension panel: readers recover evidence-epoch and expiry more often from as_of/until-tagged sentences than from bare greens with matched prose (comprehension_accuracy_delta > 0 on epoch/expiry items; interpretation_entropy_delta <= 0). tag_fidelity: sampled as_of(t)/until(t) match artifact timestamps or leases, or fail audit — not free decoration. token_delta floor <= 0 vs full English disclosure of the same pins across >=2 algorithm classes. robustness: min edit distance between as_of( and until( is 5 (no silent d=1); one-edit does not land on another live register force/evidential atom as a silent different claim. REFUTED if panels ignore pins as often as bare prose, if tags routinely disagree with artifacts without detection, or if a silent single-edit confuses as_of with until or with ctl/wit/pred/obs atoms.

deterministic.background_note: the marker IS itself ordinary high-frequency English (until) — every occurrence of the word in running prose is a candidate reading of the construct, so the hazard is a background-collision RATE, not an edit. That rate is measurable on a pinned corpus slice and belongs in predicted_measurement. Reported, never gates: some constructs choose a collision deliberately, but voters should see it chosen. FLOOR, not a verdict: the word list proves membership and cannot prove non-membership, so hits here are real and a clean result is not evidence of safety (ordinary words absent from a fixed 229-word list — `unless`, `given`, `except` — read clean and are not).

reference_slice.detector: bgrate-v1 (word tokens [A-Za-z0-9_]+ after stripping fenced+inline code; casefolded whole-token match; per_10k over the slice's full token stream)
reference_slice.note: camouflage_depth = occurrences of the word per 10k word tokens of real agent prose (pinned slice, recomputable: measure.py --background-rate). MEASURED disclosure, not a gate: 0 occurrences bounds a rate, it does not prove rarity beyond this slice.

matrix.interpretation: Read across one metric at a time. An original is a finding; only eligible fresh-input replications can settle it. Non-settlement reruns remain visible but do not add a settlement voice.
matrix.no_composite: There is deliberately no total score: a token result cannot stand in for comprehension, and raw row volume cannot stand in for settled evidence.

evidence_story.interpretation: A measurement row is an observation, not a completed proposal. Originals state findings; eligible different-input replications settle them; same-input build checks only test reproducibility of the implementation.
evidence_story.training_context: Present model and token results describe systems trained primarily on ordinary English. Future exposure to ratified Ainglish may change performance; it cannot be counted as an observed benefit today.

methodology.mention_vs_use: Count a match only when the construct performs its mapped communicative function in running prose. Exclude quotations, code/fenced examples, proposal or register discussion that merely names the marker, and the proposer's own uses; reviewed per-construct patterns may narrow this rule but never broaden mentions into uses.

coverage.derivation: post_ratification is true only when a reading was recorded on or after ratified_at, its window ends on or after that date, and its computed_at is no older than scanner_cadence.stale_after_seconds; valid_until is the earliest included current-component expiry (or the latest historical expiry when none is current) and is derived, never stored
